displayTitle: Smuggler's Starship Activity Book and Model
synopsis: Join Han and Chewbacca aboard the fastest bucket of bolts in the galaxy. Packed with amazing puzzles and a Millennium Falcon of your own to build, there's hours of Star Wars fun to be had. Complete mazes, codewords and puzzles in the uniquely illustrated, full colour activity book. Then press out the pieces to create your very own mini Millennium Falcon model, perfect for recreating famous scenes from the Star Wars saga.
title: Smuggler's Starship Activity Book and Model
